column1: # Contract conformance cases (P0 skeleton)
# Format: id|rule|clause|kind|env|command|expect|prereq
# kind:    js | cli | file | http | cabi | manual
# env:     "-" or K=V (applies to js/cli)
# expect:  js   -> literal last stdout line
#          cli  -> exit:N | stdout_has:TEXT | stdout_absent:TEXT
#          file -> has:TEXT | hasnot:TEXT
#          http -> 200 | sse | json
#          cabi -> present
#          manual -> -
# prereq names the REAL resource the case runs against, or marks it as a
# pure (static-fixture / in-process) check. The two prefixes are the only
# ones the register uses:
#   real:   a real local resource — the running binary, a real local MCP
#           file server, a real local store, a real child process, or an
#           existing local GGUF selected through SOFUU_CONTRACT_MODEL.
#   pure:   a static fixture or an in-process computation. Valid for
#           parsing, serialization and deterministic calculation only; never
#           evidence of inference, of an executed tool or of a network
#           exchange.
# A case that cannot run against its resource must BLOCK (exit 2, a
# "BLOCKED:" line) — never skip, never answer from a substitute.
